name: acp-inspector
description: Tailwind and daisyUI development toolchain for generating and verifying the ACP Inspector's committed production stylesheet. Node is not required to build or run the tool from a valid checkout.

scripts.css:check: tailwindcss -i crates/app/style/input.css -o node_modules/.cache/sheet.css && diff -u crates/app/style/sheet.css node_modules/.cache/sheet.css
